coder_notes: Randomised double-blind placebo-controlled phase 2 of ADI-PEG 20 added to Stupp. The primary outcome mentions 'associated biomarkers' without naming one, and keywords mention argininosuccinate synthetase only as a keyword, so no biomarker rows. Eligibility allows both IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma, so IDH is not an entry requirement. ADI-PEG 20 has no INN in the record; coded with the development name as written. Plasma PK and plasma citrulline/arginine pharmacodynamics are planned (blood), coded target engagement yes.
